description.value: The Outpost Liquor Store is a retail liquor shop in Maple Ridge operated by Springs Group, a regional hospitality company running 13+ liquor stores and several brew pubs across the Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley. The store stocks a hand-picked selection of cold beer, wine, and spirits and offers online ordering with curbside pickup and delivery. It sits on Dewdney Trunk Road, a common cycling corridor through Maple Ridge.

address.value: 23988 Dewdney Trunk Rd. Maple Ridge, BC V4R 1W2

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a real, operating retail liquor store at 23988 Dewdney Trunk Rd, Maple Ridge, BC V4R 1W2, part of the Springs Group chain. Phone (604) 463-1555 and email outpostlrs@springsgroup.ca are listed on the location page. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website; curbside/delivery ordering is explicitly offered.
concerns: OSM name is 'Outpost Liquor Store' but the website consistently uses 'The Outpost Liquor Store' — minor name discrepancy.
OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, publicly accessible retail liquor store confirmed open by the website. Useful to touring cyclists for resupply on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge.
